body: Why not disable `grpc.WithBlock` ?  It seems `grpc` can handle connection issues like this automatically in the background if  `grpc.WithBlock` is disabled.
@westhood I think the code should confirm it can connect to some endpoint before returning a client, but non-blocking connect is a possible alternative.
